{{Dialogue|Ozzel|Get us through that opening!|Comet|But sir, we've got them on the defensive&mdash;|Ozzel|I am still in command here and you will do as I say.|Comet|Spitter, get us out of here.|Spitter|Yes, sir.|attr=Admiral Ozzel, Comet, and Spitter in a commandeered Armored Assault Tank on Khorm|src=<ref name="ISotR 2" />}}
'''Comet''' was a [[Corporal/Legends|clone trooper corporal]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Under the command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]], Comet was part of the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] known as the [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]], a [[unit]] in the [[104th Battalion/Legends|104th Battalion]]. Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Comet participated in the [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|Battle of Khorm]], in which he fought against [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist droid forces]] as the [[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] [[Army/Legends|Army]] struggled to secure the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Agrocite/Legends|agrocite]] deposits from the [[Khormai/Legends|Khormai]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Unger Gout]] and the [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. Comet was captured during the battle along with [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Spitter]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Wolffe, and [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]]. The [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] later escaped in a commandeered [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]] after [[Slicer/Legends|hot-wiring]] the control panel of the [[Prison/Legends|cell]] in which they were being held. Later in the battle, Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]] vanquished the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] army, resulting in the seizure of the agrocite deposits of Khorm.

Comet also helped in the [[Mission to Vanqor/Legends|rescuing]] of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] on the planet [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]] after the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had been trapped on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the downed [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']]. Under the command of Master Koon, [[General/Legends|General]] Skywalker, and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], the [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] and a squad of clones helped [[Second Battle of Felucia/Legends|destroy]] a Separatist-controlled [[Separatist outpost (Felucia)/Legends|outpost]] on the planet [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] that had recently been supplied with reinforcements by the Separatist General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Comet also took part in the [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|rescue]] of a trapped Jedi force on the planet [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]], and the [[Battle of Kadavo/Legends|liberation]] of a group of kidnapped [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] colonists from the planet [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]], who had been taken by [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] to a [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|labor processing plant]] on [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]]. Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Comet and the rest of the Wolfpack helped discover the wreck of [[Death/Legends|deceased]] Jedi Master [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]]' [[775519/Legends|ship]] on the [[Oba Diah moon/Legends|desert moon of Oba Diah]].

==Biography==
===Early service===
{{Quote|Comet, hold that junction breaker open while I rewire the circuit. With any luck, the lock will reset.|Spitter, to Comet, inside Khorm's agrocite processing facility|<ref name="ISotR 2" />}}
Comet was the name taken by a [[Corporal/Legends|clone trooper corporal]]<ref name="pl">{{TCW|Padawan Lost}}</ref> who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]]. As a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]], Comet was [[Cloning/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] as a genetic copy of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="SWE" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Comet was assigned to the [[Wolfpack/Legends|Wolfpack]], a clone [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] that was part of the [[104th Battalion/Legends|104th Battalion]], and served under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|CC-3636]], nicknamed "Wolffe."<ref name="r2ch">{{TCW|R2 Come Home}}</ref>

Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Comet, along with the rest of the Wolfpack and the [[44th Special Operations Division|44th's]] [[Devil Dogs]], participated in the [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|Battle of Khorm]] to secure a rare [[Ore/Legends|ore]] called [[Agrocite/Legends|agrocite]], [[Mining/Legends|mined]] because it could be used as [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] and also greatly enhanced [[Laser/Legends|beam]] weapons. Led by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Masters Koon, [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], and [[Tauht]], as well as the recently promoted [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]], Comet and the Republic task force arrived on the planet [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]]. However, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] they arrived there, the [[Khormai/Legends|Khormai]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Unger Gout]] had allied himself with the Separatists and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] his people to [[Miner/Legends|mine]] for the Confederacy. To make matters worse, the enemy had also built a [[weather-control station]], creating a storm in Khorm's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] that would prevent the Republic forces from using their air support until the station was destroyed.<ref name="ISotR1" />

[[File:Comet_drives_an_AAT.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Comet pilots the commandeered Armored Assault Tank.]]
In the initial [[Ground warfare/Legends|attack]] by the Republic, the task force managed to drive the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] back from the [[agrocite processing facility]], where Gout currently resided, forcing the warlord to abandon the plant. After capturing the facility, Masters Koon and Fisto took a clone unit and departed to destroy the weather station, placing Tauht in command of the Republic's current position. Tauht would later be [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], sent by the Confederacy to secure the planet, leaving Ozzel in charge. When the Confederacy mounted a counterattack, Ozzel ordered Comet and the rest of the Republic forces to leave their position at the facility and charge the enemy. Although they at first gained the upper hand against the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] forces, hidden [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|spider droids]] surrounded the attack force with which Comet fought, destroying most of it. Comet, one of the few survivors of the battle, was taken [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] alongside Ozzel, Wolffe, and trooper [[Spitter]] by Gout.<ref name="ISotR1" />

Comet and the other prisoners were held at the agrocite processing plant, once again under enemy control. He and the others escaped imprisonment after they managed to [[Slicer/Legends|hot-wire]] the control panel to their [[Prison/Legends|cell]]. Commandeering an [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]], Comet and his fellow troopers destroyed any [[Droid/Legends|droids]] who tried to stop them as they escaped from the processing plant. Ventress, at the time engaged with the Republic force sent to destroy the weather-control station, was informed of their escape and raced to stop them. Comet and the others managed to reach a Republic staging point and rendezvous with the Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]] located there.<ref name="ISotR 2" />

After Ventress and her attack force tracked the group of escapees to the staging point, the droids launched their assault, and the commandeered Armored Assault [[Tank/Legends|Tank]] was immediately destroyed. The attack forced Comet and the remaining Republic troops to take cover behind the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]] and [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE walkers]] that had been frozen to the ground by Khorm's climate and rendered useless. As the battle at the staging point raged on, Republic troops under Masters Koon and Fisto managed to destroy the weather-control station, which allowed Republic forces under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wieler]] to reach the staging area. The reinforcements, which included [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] and [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]], destroyed much of Ventress's attack force, causing her to order a retreat which saved Comet and the remainder of the ground force.<ref name="ISotR 2" /> The Republic forces on Khorm later triumphed, resulting in the securing of the agrocite resources and the death of Gout, which forced Ventress to flee the lost Confederate cause on Khorm.<ref name="ISoTR3">[[The Clone Wars 9|''The Clone Wars'' 9]]</ref>

===Rescue missions===
{{Quote|Comet, let's go!|Commander Wolffe, to Comet, shortly before they rescue Skywalker and Windu on Vanqor|<ref name="r2ch" />}}
[[File:Comet_helping_windu.png|thumb|right|270px|Comet (middle) helping Windu to the gunship]]
Later in the war, after receiving word that [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] had been [[Sabotage of the Endurance/Legends|trapped]] on the world [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]] by [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters, Comet and the Wolfpack departed from the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for the [[Uziel system]], tasked with [[Mission to Vanqor/Legends|rescuing]] the Jedi. Accompanied by Plo Koon and Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], Comet and the task force were flown down to the wreckage of the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']], where Windu and Skywalker had been trapped on the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser's]] [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]]. Comet and the rescue team hovered outside of the ''Endurance''{{'s}} bridge in the LAAT/i [[Plo's Bros/Legends|''Plo's Bros'']] as the bridge began to give way. While the Jedi used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|prevent]] the bridge from falling as the Wolfpack troopers secured it to the gunship with [[Ascension gun/Legends|ascension cables]], Comet and Wolffe attempted to extract Windu and Skywalker from the bridge. Finding the Jedi trapped beneath debris from an explosion, Comet helped Windu from the rubble and into the gunship while Wolffe aided Skywalker in escaping. When both injured Jedi were on board, the gunship departed the wreckage, leaving the bridge to collapse [[Standard second|seconds]] later. Briefly stopping at a staging point to load the Jedi onto [[gurney]]s, Comet and the task force departed from Vanqor along with the rescued Jedi.<ref name="r2ch" />

As the Clone Wars raged on, Comet participated in a [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|rescue]] of a Republic team sent to the planet [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]], a Confederate-controlled world. It was there that the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]] stood, a high-security prison meant for important prisoners. The Republic team had been tasked with infiltrating the prison and rescuing Jedi Master [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]], who had recently been [[Capture of Even Piell/Legends|captured]] after he obtained the coordinates for the [[Nexus Route/Legends|Nexus Route]], a secret [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace lane]] that connected both Republic and Confederate worlds. The strike team had successfully rescued Piell and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], who each knew half of the hyperlane coordinates. However, during their attempt to escape the planet, their [[Shuttle 81572/Legends|shuttle]] was destroyed, and the team was forced to hide in the wilderness of Lola Sayu, waiting for the Republic attack force to come to their aid.<ref name="CR">{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}}</ref>

Aboard a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of ''Venator''-class [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], Comet traveled to the [[Lola Sayu system/Legends|Lola Sayu system]] with the attack force that was led by Koon and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Wolffe. There, the Republic force managed to [[Space warfare/Legends|break through]] the [[Lola Sayu defense fleet/Legends|Lola Sayu defense fleet]], and a [[Space gunship/Legends|space gunship]] containing Koon, Wolffe and Comet attempted an evacuation of the survivors of the rescue team. Comet and the retrieval team reached the extraction point in the gunship, where the survivors of the mission had just defeated a squad of [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commando droids]] on [[Repulsorlift/Legends|flying]] [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|STAPs]] led by the [[Phindian/Legends|Phindian]] [[Warden/Legends|warden]] of the prison, [[Osi Sobeck/Legends|Osi Sobeck]]. As ranks of [[LM-432 crab droid/Legends|crab droids]] surrounded the extraction point and attempted to halt the escape, the remains of the rescue team boarded the gunship and departed for a fleet of ''Venator''-class Star Destroyers that were engaged with the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] above the planet. The gunship containing Comet and the others successfully boarded one of the cruisers, and the remnants of the Republic fleet departed for Coruscant, their mission a success.<ref name="CR" />

===Fighting on Felucia===
{{Quote|Hold up, I sense something out there.''"<br />"''A droid?''"<br />"''I don't think so; it's probably just an animal.''"<br />"''Stay alert men. Let's move.|Padawan Ahsoka Tano and Comet|<ref name="pl" />}}
At a later point, Comet was present with Commander Wolffe and the Wolfpack on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], a highly contested planet in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], as they [[Second Battle of Felucia/Legends|fought]] to free it from the droid forces occupying an [[Separatist outpost (Felucia)/Legends|outpost]] commanded by the [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] [[TZ-33/Legends|TZ-33]]. Shortly after droid reinforcements sent by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] arrived in a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|Confederate landing craft]], Republic forces launched their assault, aiming to drive the Separatists back and eventually gain control of the planet. Republic AT-TE [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] targeted the enemy in the outpost and opened [[Laser/Legends|fire]], causing TZ-33 to retaliate by opening up the front gate and sending a unit of spider droids to engage the walkers. Attempting to gain access to the Separatist outpost via the open entrance, an attack group led by Anakin Skywalker and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], nicknamed "Rex," pounced on the droids as they exited the gate and plowed forward.<ref name="pl" />

Meanwhile, Plo Koon led Wolffe and a squad of the Wolfpack over the left wall of the outpost to flank the droids by using their [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpacks]], while Ahsoka Tano was in charge of a small division of clones including Comet, [[Sinker/Legends|Sinker]], and [[Boost/Legends|Boost]], that was tasked with scaling the back wall and engaging the enemy from behind. Tano stopped the squad temporarily on the way to their objective when she [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] something. Even though she had unknowingly sensed the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] hunter [[Lo-Taren/Legends|Lo-Taren]] who was lurking nearby, Tano dismissed it as nothing, and Comet, the squad's second-in-command, ordered the men forward. The [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal's]] squad reached the back wall of the outpost, and while Tano guarded the rear of their advance, he and the other troopers scaled the wall with their ascension cables after destroying the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] guards.<ref name="pl" />

Reaching the top, Comet and the squad rendezvoused with the rest of the Wolfpack as they captured the outpost. Tano, however, never scaled the wall behind her men, as she had been secretly captured by Lo-Taren, and Comet soon became aware of her disappearance. After the outpost had been taken and all droid forces including TZ-33 destroyed, Comet reported Tano's failure to check in to his Jedi commanders. He participated in the search for the missing Padawan along with the Republic forces in that area, though none of them uncovered her whereabouts, and he along with the rest of the searchers eventually abandoned the hunt when commanded by their superiors. Unbeknownst to Comet and the others, Tano had been taken off-world by Lo-Taren to be hunted on [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]],<ref name="pl" /> though she later [[Battle on Wasskah/Legends|escaped]] from the moon.<ref name="Wook">{{TCW|Wookiee Hunt}}</ref>

===Mission to Kadavo===
{{Quote|I want the men topside with rocket packs and cable guns. Move it!|Admiral Coburn briefs Comet, along with Wolffe and Sinker|<ref name="Kadavo">{{TCW|Escape from Kadavo}}</ref>}}
[[File:WolfpackFiresCables-EFK.png|thumb|left|250px|Comet, along with Wolffe and Sinker, fire their ascension cables.]]
Comet and the Wolfpack were later dispatched to the planet [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]]<ref name="Kadavo" /> around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Annual">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> where Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], Rex, and captured [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] colonists from the world [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]] were being held at a [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|slave processing facility]]. Tasked with [[Battle of Kadavo/Legends|rescuing]] the prisoners and destroying the hub, Koon and a clone [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] destroyed the facility's defenses, allowing a [[Arquitens-class light cruiser/Legends|Republic light cruiser]] helmed by Admiral [[Coburn/Legends|Coburn]] to get close to the hub. The [[Light cruiser/Legends|light cruiser]], which held the members of the Wolfpack, came up under the facility to where the floor of the cell containing the Togruta prisoners was in the process of retracting, a trap that when fully opened would cause the Togruta to fall to their deaths in the [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] crater below. On the bridge of the cruiser with Sinker and Wolffe, Comet followed his Commander out onto the cruiser's [[Hull/Legends|hull]] when Coburn ordered them to save the prisoners.<ref name="Kadavo" />

Equipped with jetpacks and [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] armed with ascension cables, Comet and the others arrived beneath the trapped Togruta. Using the jetpacks, they fired their ascension cables at the now-exposed ceiling of the holding cell, and the Togruta used the cables to descend to the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] below. During the evacuation, Comet caught one of the Togruta who fell from the cables and safely brought her down to the cruiser. With all of the prisoners out of the cell, Comet and the others descended into the cruiser as Coburn removed the ship from underneath the facility. After gunships rescued Kenobi and Rex from a landing pad, Koon ordered the gunships to open fire, and the resulting [[Missile/Legends|missile]] volley destroyed the processing hub's supports, demolishing the facility as it crashed into the volcano mouth over which it was situated.<ref name="Kadavo" />

===Searching in the sand===
{{Quote|Can anyone hear us? Come in, please. We're not getting anything here. We're off. We must be way off.''"<br />"''Negative. It is here. The data specifically states. It has got to be.''"<br />"''We've scanned the area three times. This&mdash;this is a wasteland. There's nothing.|Comet and Wolffe on Oba Diah|<ref name="Lost One">{{TCW|The Lost One}}</ref>}}
[[File:CometInTheSand-TLO.png|thumb|right|250px|Comet and other members of Wolfpack on the desert moon of Oba Diah]]
With the Clone Wars still raging circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Death">[[Darth Maul — Death Sentence 1|''Darth Maul — Death Sentence'' 1]]</ref> Comet and the Wolfpack were sent<ref name="Lost One" /> to the [[Oba Diah moon/Legends|desert moon]] of [[Oba Diah/Legends|Oba Diah]]<ref name="Lost One ep">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep610|text="The Lost One" &ndash; ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> alongside Master Koon in order to identify the source of a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]]. With him and the Wolfpack dressed in sand-proof combat gear, Comet was at the forefront of a division of clone troopers, AT-TEs, and [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut/Legends|HAVw A6 Juggernauts]] as they searched for the source in the blowing sand on the moon. After combing a particular location where the source originated three times, Comet reported to Wolffe and Koon, who were in an A6 Juggernaut, that the clones on the ground had neither sighted nor scanned anything other than the billowing sand. Because of this, Comet suggested that they were searching in the wrong place. However, Koon ordered the Wolfpack to press on, and they shortly discovered the source of the distress signal, prompting Comet to order the contingent's vehicles to stop. The source turned out to be a crashed [[775519/Legends|T-6 shuttle]] that had been used by the deceased Jedi Master [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]], and Koon had the [[T-6 shuttle/Legends|T-6 shuttle]] transported back to Coruscant.<ref name="Lost One" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|The outpost is secured. Good job, Corporal; where is Commander Tano?''"<br />"''She was covering our flank when we scaled the wall.|Anakin Skywalker and Comet on Felucia|<ref name="pl" />}}
Comet spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]],<ref name="ISotR 2" /> and, as a clone of Jango Fett, was 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="SWE" /> Like Fett, he also had [[Color/Legends|tan]]-colored skin. After commandeering an Armored Assault Tank on Khorm, Comet realized the enemy was at a disadvantage due to the tank that his forces possessed, and wanted to press the advantage. However, Major Kendal Ozzel ordered the troopers to escape from the agrocite processing facility, prompting Comet to obey his superior.<ref name="ISotR 2" /> Comet helped assist Commander Wolffe and his squad when they rescued Anakin Skywalker and Mace Windu from the precarious bridge of the ''Endurance'',<ref name="r2ch" /> and also when he served as second-in-command during the raid on the back of the outpost on Felucia under Ahsoka Tano's command. He was complimented by Skywalker on Felucia after he and his squad completed their objective.<ref name="pl" />

==Equipment==
Early in the war, Comet donned [[Clone cold assault trooper/Legends|clone cold assault armor]] emblazoned with red to participate in the Battle of Khorm without the negative affects of the cold on that planet,<ref name="ISotR1" /> and would go on to use sand-proof combat gear on the moon of Oba Diah.<ref name="Lost One" /> Later in the war, he wore standard [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]], which he customized with a gray-blue color<ref name="r2ch" /> to honor the fallen members of the Wolfpack during the [[Battle of Abregado/Legends|Battle of Abregado]].<ref name="Hasbro Clones Video">{{CN|url=promos/201007_secretcode/tools/downloads/video2/index.html|text="Clones" Video}}</ref> Prior to the mission to Kadavo, Comet upgraded his Phase I [[Armor/Legends|armor]] to the [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|second phase]] of the clone armor. Like his Phase I set, it featured the same colors. His weapon was a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]], which was sometimes equipped with the ascension cable launcher that could be attached to the blaster. Occasionally, Comet used a jetpack for missions.<ref name="Kadavo" />

==Behind the scenes==
Comet first appeared in [[2009]]'s [[Star Wars comic books|graphic novel]] story arc [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: In Service of the Republic|''In Service of the Republic'']], written by [[Henry Gilroy]].<ref name="ISotR1" /> He also appeared in several episodes of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, with his first appearance in [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|Season Two's]] "[[R2 Come Home]]," released in [[2010]].<ref name="r2ch" /> He later appeared in both "[[Citadel Rescue]]" and "[[Padawan Lost]]" from [[2011]]'s [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|Season Three]],<ref name="pl" /><ref name="CR" /> and the episode "[[Escape from Kadavo]]" in the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]], released in [[2012]].<ref name="Kadavo" /> In the [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|sixth and final season]] of ''The Clone Wars'', Comet appeared in the episode "[[The Lost One]]," released in [[2014]].<ref name="Lost One" /> Comet was voiced in the series by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who also voiced all of the clone troopers in the series.<ref name="pl" /> In Wolffe's [[Encyclopedia (StarWars.com)|Encyclopedia]] [http://www.starwars.com/explore/encyclopedia/characters/clonecommanderwolffe/#!/media entry] on [[StarWars.com]], slide 7 in the Video/Images section displays Comet instead of Wolffe.<ref name="Wolffe">{{SWE|characters|clonecommanderwolffe|Clone Commander Wolffe}}</ref>
